title: Data protection, encryption and controlled retention
workflow: Inventory customer, ledger, credentials and audit datasets
Assign sensitivity, lawful purpose and residency obligations
Apply encryption at rest/in transit and bounded key scopes
Define minimized API/log/event payloads and pseudonymization
Enforce justified retention, archival and lawful deletion workflows
Audit data access and test backup/restore under confidentiality
invariants: Statutory retention must be verified by legal source, not guessed
Posted financial evidence is not deleted to satisfy a generic user request
Public object URLs cannot expose identity documents
Sensitive backups require identical encryption and access controls
Secrets and raw customer identifiers excluded from general telemetry
planned_tests: Retention job respects active legal hold
Cross-region replication policy denies unknown location
Data export includes actor and approved purpose
approval_gate: Institution privacy/residency policy, qualified legal retention review, key policy and recovery-security tests.
